Welcome
Oak Lodge School provides a nurturing learning environment, tailored to individual students, meeting a range of special educational needs. Our MISSION - all students to become healthy, creative, independent citizens and prepared for adulthood.
Read more
GET IN TOUCH!

British Values
Promoting Fundamental British Values
We aim to actively promote British values in school to ensure young people leave school prepared for life in modern Britain. Pupils are encouraged to regard people of all faiths, races and cultures with respect and tolerance and understand that while different people may hold different views about what is ‘right’ and ‘wrong’, all people living in England are subject to its law.
Promoting British Values in our School
· We recognise that it is unacceptable to dismiss the beliefs and opinions of anyone
· We understand that discussions about sensitive issues will be controlled and structured
· We all have a responsibility to promote and protect the well-being of others
To support us in this we have:
· Celebrating festivals (Harvest Festival and Christmas)
· Learning about other cultures
· Outdoor learning and visits
· We are free to think as we see fit
· We have the freedom to make choices that affect us but we recognise that we are accountable for all our actions
To support us in this we have:
· Opportunities to make choices in a safe environment.
· Achievement Assembly
· We can influence the way school runs through student parliament and by talking to staff
· We can influence our lessons by responding appropriately
To support us in this we have:
· Election of School Parliament
· School Parliament decision making
· We understand that the school rules are used to mirror society laws and must be recognised
· We recognise that there will be consequences for my actions
· We recognise that we are all equally responsible for our learning as the teacher
To support us in this we have:
· Assemblies with RRE focus
· Links with local police
· Parent Questionnaire
· We recognise that everyone is entitled to their opinions as long as it does not promote extremism
· We understand that everyone is entitled to a voice within the classroom
· We will listen to others as we would like to be listened to
To support us in this we have:
democracy
rule of law
individual liberty
mutual respect
GET IN TOUCH!

pageCache.pageTitle: Vision and Values | Oak Lodge School
pageCache.text:
Vision and Values
The pupils are at the centre of all we do at Oak Lodge. The core values are the building blocks upon which we provide every child with every opportunity to SHINE.
Our vision is built around a personalised learning approach, developing programmes of study, including access to high quality therapeutic input, to meet the needs of each pupil. Working in partnership with external agencies we aim to ensure that every child develops holistically within our engaging and inclusive curriculum.
We aim to prepare every child for life beyond Oak Lodge providing them with a toolkit of skills to navigate their adult life. Our curriculum is designed to develop academic knowledge alongside social, emotional and mental health awareness; building resilient and confident young people who leave us with ‘Outstanding Achievement and Knowledge for Life’.
GET IN TOUCH!

About Us
Pages within the About Us menu:
Vision and Values
Provision
British Values
Community Links
GET IN TOUCH!

Welcome
A warm welcome to Oak Lodge School
Welcome to Oak Lodge school, a specialist secondary school on the edge of the New Forest National Park for around 160 pupils aged 11-16. Our nurturing and therapeutic learning environment caters for students with a range of needs including Autistic Spectrum Condition; social, communication and sensory needs; severe, moderate and specific learning difficulties and mental health needs.
Our school vision encourages all pupils to gain outstanding achievement and knowledge for life with the aim of ensuring they are well prepared for adulthood, independent living and employment.
Personalised targets help to equip pupils for life beyond school and help them to make good progress across our broad and varied curriculum. Our life curriculum and vibrant Arts programme also supports pupils to embed the key skills of communication, reading and personal development.
I hope you find everything you need to know about our school on our website. If you would like any further information please contact our school office by telephone on 02380 847213 or email reception@oaklodge.school and we will be pleased to help.
GET IN TOUCH!

pageCache.pageTitle: Spiritual, Moral, Social & Cultural Education | Oak Lodge School
pageCache.text:
Spiritual, Moral, Social & Cultural Education
At Oak Lodge School we realise that the personal development of pupils, spiritually, morally, socially and culturally, plays a significant part in their ability to learn and achieve.
We therefore aim to provide an education that provides pupils with opportunities to explore and develop their own values, beliefs and spiritual awareness; high standards of personal behaviour; a positive caring attitude towards other people; understanding their social and cultural traditions and an appreciation of the diversity and richness of the culture.
GET IN TOUCH!

Music
Music at Oak Lodge School
Music at Oak Lodge School gives students the chance to explore sound, rhythm, and creativity through playing instruments, singing, and listening to different types of music. Pupils learn to express themselves and develop their confidence through musical activities that suit their individual needs and abilities.
The lessons focus on enjoyment, self-expression, and teamwork, helping students build skills in playing music and understanding different styles. Music encourages students to be creative, work together, and appreciate the power of music in their lives.

GET IN TOUCH!

Art
Art at Oak Lodge School
Art at Oak Lodge School provides pupils with a creative and expressive outlet, allowing them to develop confidence, fine motor skills, and self-expression in a supportive and inclusive environment. Our curriculum is tailored to meet individual needs, encouraging students to explore different artistic techniques and materials in a way that is accessible and engaging.
Lessons cover a variety of creative disciplines, including drawing, painting, sculpture, collage, and digital art, while also introducing pupils to the work of different artists and cultures.
Through Art, students develop not only practical skills but also imagination, problem-solving abilities, and emotional expression. Our goal is to foster a love for creativity while building skills that support communication, well-being, and personal achievement.
Intent, Implementation and Impact
GET IN TOUCH!

Computing
Computing at Oak Lodge School
Computing at Oak Lodge School is designed to equip pupils with essential digital skills that will support their learning, personal development, and future opportunities. Our curriculum focuses on providing students with the knowledge and confidence to use technology effectively, while fostering problem-solving, creativity, and independence.
Lessons cover a range of topics, including basic computer skills, internet safety, data management, and the use of multimedia tools. Through hands-on activities, interactive learning, and the use of assistive technology, pupils gain practical experience in using devices and software to enhance their communication, creativity, and everyday life.
The Computing program is designed to meet the individual needs of each student, ensuring that they can engage with technology in a way that is accessible and enjoyable. Our aim is to help pupils develop digital literacy and critical thinking skills, preparing them for both academic success and a future in a technology-driven world.

GET IN TOUCH!

Humanities
Humanities at Oak Lodge School
Humanities at Oak Lodge School introduces students to the world around them through subjects like history, geography, and social studies. Pupils explore important events, places, and people from the past and present, helping them understand different cultures and societies.
The lessons focus on curiosity, critical thinking, and reflection, allowing students to engage with real-world topics in a way that is accessible and meaningful. Humanities helps students develop an understanding of the world, encouraging them to think about their place in it and how they can make a positive impact
Intent, Implementation and Impact
GET IN TOUCH!

Maths
Maths at Oak Lodge School
Maths at Oak Lodge School is designed to develop essential numeracy, problem-solving, and life skills in a way that is accessible, engaging, and tailored to the individual needs of our pupils. Our curriculum focuses on building confidence in basic arithmetic, practical maths, and real-world applications.
Lessons cover key areas such as number recognition, measurement, money handling, time, shapes, and problem-solving, ensuring students gain the mathematical skills needed for both independent living and further education. By creating a supportive and inclusive learning environment, we aim to make maths meaningful, enjoyable, and relevant to everyday life, helping every pupil achieve their full potential.
Intent, Implementation and Impact
GET IN TOUCH!

Science
Science at Oak Lodge School
Science at Oak Lodge School is designed to develop curiosity, critical thinking, and an understanding of the world through hands-on, practical learning. Our curriculum is tailored to the individual needs of our pupils, making scientific concepts accessible, engaging, and relevant to everyday life.
Lessons cover key areas such as biology, chemistry, and physics, focusing on topics like the human body, plants and animals, materials, forces, electricity, and the environment.
By fostering inquiry, problem-solving, and observation skills, we aim to build confidence and a sense of achievement in all students. Science at Oak Lodge encourages exploration and discovery, helping pupils develop an awareness of the world around them in a supportive and inclusive environment.

GET IN TOUCH!

ASDAN
ASDAN at Oak Lodge School
ASDAN (Award Scheme Development and Accreditation Network) at Oak Lodge School is designed to provide pupils with valuable opportunities to develop practical skills, independence, and confidence in a structured yet flexible learning environment. The curriculum is tailored to meet the individual needs of students, focusing on both personal growth and life skills that prepare them for adulthood.
Through the ASDAN program, pupils work towards accredited qualifications that help build skills in areas such as communication, teamwork, problem-solving, budgeting, and employability. The program is delivered through a mix of hands-on activities, real-world experiences, and interactive learning, ensuring that each student can engage with tasks at their own level.
Our goal is to provide students with a sense of achievement, empowering them to become more independent and confident in both everyday tasks and future aspirations. ASDAN offers pupils a meaningful pathway that enhances their social, academic, and practical abilities, giving them the skills to thrive in both school and the wider community.

Design Technology
Design Technology at Oak Lodge School
Design Technology at Oak Lodge School helps students explore their creativity by designing and making different products. Pupils learn to use materials like wood, metal, fabric, and digital tools, while developing skills in problem-solving, planning, and decision-making.
Students work on practical projects, learning about safety, design, and how things are made. The lessons are tailored to meet each student's needs, making the subject both accessible and fun.
Design Technology encourages critical thinking and independent learning, giving students valuable skills for everyday life and future opportunities.
Intent, Implementation and Impact
GET IN TOUCH!

Digital Media
Digital Media at Oak Lodge School
Digital Media at Oak Lodge School offers students the opportunity to explore and develop creative and technical skills in the digital world. The curriculum is designed to engage pupils in multimedia production, including video editing, photography, graphic design, and audio production, in a way that is accessible and tailored to their individual needs.
Students learn to use a variety of digital tools and software to create and manipulate content, allowing them to express themselves creatively and develop practical skills for personal and professional use. The course emphasizes problem-solving, communication, and collaboration, providing pupils with the confidence to experiment and explore different aspects of digital media.
Through a hands-on, interactive approach, pupils gain experience in planning, producing, and presenting digital projects, all while learning about online safety, ethics, and the impact of digital media on society. Our goal is to inspire creativity, foster technical skills, and encourage critical thinking, helping students build a foundation for future opportunities in the digital world.

Duke of Edinburgh
Duke of Edinburgh (DofE) at Oak Lodge School
The Duke of Edinburgh Award (DofE) at Oak Lodge School helps students build confidence, life skills, and independence through fun and meaningful activities. The program encourages pupils to try new challenges and work towards goals in areas like volunteering, fitness, skills development, and outdoor adventures.
The award is adapted to meet the individual needs of each student, with a focus on teamwork, problem-solving, and self-growth. By taking part, students gain a sense of achievement and pride, while preparing for future opportunities and learning important skills for life.

Ethics
Ethics at Oak Lodge School
Ethics at Oak Lodge School helps students think about right and wrong, and how to make good choices. Pupils discuss important topics like fairness, kindness, and respect for others, and learn how their actions affect the world around them.
The lessons focus on values, understanding different viewpoints, and making thoughtful decisions. Ethics encourages students to think deeply, be kind, and treat others with respect in everyday life.

Food Technology
Food Technology at Oak Lodge School
Food Technology at Oak Lodge School teaches students how to prepare and cook food safely. Pupils learn about healthy eating, basic cooking skills, and how to make simple meals.
The lessons focus on practical skills, health, and creativity, helping students gain confidence in the kitchen. Food Technology encourages students to enjoy cooking, make healthy choices, and develop skills that can be used in everyday life.
